content.title: About
content.content: Reduced‑fat hot dog is a low‑fat sausage made from lean meat (usually beef or turkey) placed in a soft bun. Part of the fat is removed during processing, lowering the calorie count without dramatically changing the taste. The product is ready to eat after a short heating.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Fat reduction is achieved by using lean cuts and mechanical fat‑extraction techniques.
In the United States these hot dogs are often sold in packs of 4–6 and are a popular quick snack.
Some versions contain added plant fibers to improve texture and increase satiety.
The bun is typically made from wheat flour, but whole‑grain options are available for added nutrition.
Reduced‑fat hot dogs are frequently offered at sporting events and school cafeterias.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Reduced fat content helps lower the overall calorie load, which can be beneficial for weight management.

items.title: High‑quality protein
items.content: Lean meat provides complete protein essential for muscle repair and maintenance.

items.title: Contains iron
items.content: The meat supplies heme iron, supporting normal blood formation.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: The product provides vitamin B12 and niacin, which aid energy metabolism.

items.title: Convenient and quick
items.content: Ready to eat after a brief reheating, it offers a fast meal option.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Like most processed meats, it can be high in salt, which should be considered by people with hypertension.

items.title: Meat allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to meat ingredients.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: Preservatives may be used to extend shelf life, which some consumers prefer to avoid.

items.title: Gluten in the bun
items.content: The bun contains wheat, making the product unsuitable for those with celiac disease.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the hot dog in the microwave (30–45 seconds) or on a skillet, place it in the bun, and add your favorite condiments such as mustard, ketchup, pickles, or fresh vegetables.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store refrigerated at 0‑4 °C in the original packaging. Once opened, consume within 3–4 days. When frozen, quality is maintained for up to 2 months.
